summary: The Town of Quarry Bend wants the plumbing fixtures replaced in the public restrooms at Town Hall and the Quarry Bend Library: 14 toilets, 6 urinals and 12 sinks, with sensor-operated flush valves and faucets, new stop valves and repair of disturbed finishes. The Town's estimate is $65,000 and the work must be finished by May 28, 2027. Bids are due by 2:00 p.m. on Wednesday, March 24, 2027 at the Town Clerk's office, delivered or by email.

notes.text: The text never says outright that this job is reserved for small businesses. It says the Town's Small Purchase Policy limits purchases under $75,000 to small businesses with fewer than 100 employees, the Town's estimate is $65,000, and the bid must carry a small business certification. I read that as meaning only small businesses, by the Town's definition of fewer than 100 employees, may bid. The text does not say what happens if bids come in at $75,000 or more.

A performance bond is required only if the contract price is more than $50,000. The Town's estimate is $65,000, so I read the bond as required for a bid near the estimate; a bid of $50,000 or less would not need one. The text does not give the bond amount or a deadline for it, and does not mention a payment bond.

Bids may be delivered or sent by email, but the text gives no email address for bids; the only address is the Town Clerk's in the contact section. The questions deadline has a date but no time, and the text does not say where to send questions.
The work must be done one restroom at a time so that each building always has a restroom in service, and must be finished by May 28, 2027. The text does not say how many restrooms each building has.

The fixture counts (14 toilets, 6 urinals, 12 sinks) are totals for both buildings and are not split by building, although the Bid Form asks for a price for each building. There is no organized site visit; the buildings may be visited during business hours without an appointment.
